Fresno Cycling Club Monthly Birthday Rides

Fresno, CA · Woodward Park area · Road

Fresno Cycling Club Monthly Birthday Rides is a road group ride in Fresno, CA. It rolls monthly, on a Saturday at 8:00 am from Steven's parking lot. Pace: b, C and C/D groups with leaders.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: b, C and C/D groups with leaders. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Fresno Cycling Club Monthly Birthday Rides group ride

The Fresno Cycling Club, going since 1962, runs a monthly birthday ride with B, C and C/D groups heading into the foothills toward Millerton, Humphreys or Tollhouse. Each group has a leader. The club rates rides by pace and terrain so you can pick the right one.
